purpose: Preserve the active fact-confirmation behavior while hardening feature acceptance so contracts are externally pinned, exact artifact identity is bound, native/opaque execution fails closed, real installed validators can run on source roots, and new regressions are surfaced without replacing AI intent judgment.

requirements.statement: No functional contract remains INCONCLUSIVE, while explicit functional contracts execute deterministic scenarios.
Installed ruff, bandit, mypy, pytest, and coverage are discovered and can be executed on source roots without auto-installing missing validators.
Previous verification results can be compared and newly failing facts are returned as regressions.
Acceptance requires both locked_sha256 and an external pre-implementation pin and returns exact target_sha256 facts.
Native or opaque targets must not execute directly on the host and are BLOCKED_NEEDS_SANDBOX.
The runner never decides user intent; acceptance output remains facts-only and hands off to AI intent assessment.
